'''Richard Teng''' is a Singaporean business executive who is the [[co-chief executive officer]] (CEO) of [[Binance]], a [[cryptocurrency exchange]]. Previously, he worked for the [[Monetary Authority of Singapore]] and was chief regulatory officer of the [[Singapore Exchange]] and CEO of the [[Abu Dhabi Global Market]].

==Early life and education==
Teng was born in [[Singapore]].<ref name=National>{{cite news |last1=Cabral |first1=Alvin R. |title=Richard Teng: the former Abu Dhabi financial regulator named as new Binance chief |url=https://www.thenationalnews.com/business/cryptocurrencies/2023/11/22/who-is-new-binance-chief-executive-richard-teng/ |work=[[The National (Abu Dhabi)|The National]] |date=November 22, 2023}}</ref> He earned an accounting degree from [[Nanyang Technological University]] and a [[master's degree]] in applied finance from the [[University of Western Australia]].<ref name=Mint>{{cite news |title=Binance gets new CEO amid US money laundering probe – Who is Richard Teng? |url=https://www.livemint.com/news/world/binance-gets-new-ceo-amid-us-money-laundering-probe-who-is-richard-teng-11701091590480.html |work=[[Mint (newspaper)|Mint]] |date=28 November 2023}}</ref>

==Career==
Teng was a [[civil servant]] and business executive in the financial and regulatory sectors for three decades.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Lacqua |first1=Francine |last2=Nicolle |first2=Emily |title=Binance's Top Executive Team to 'Remain Intact,' New CEO Says |url=https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2023-11-29/binance-top-executive-team-to-remain-intact-new-ceo-teng-says |publisher=Bloomberg News |date=November 29, 2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Wilson |first1=Tom |last2=Howcroft |first2=Elizabeth |title=Binance CEO Teng braced for uphill battle in post-Zhao era |url=https://www.reuters.com/technology/binance-ceo-teng-braced-uphill-battle-post-zhao-era-2023-11-24/ |publisher=Reuters |date=November 24, 2023}}</ref> He was the director of [[corporate finance]] at the [[Monetary Authority of Singapore]], where he worked for thirteen years.{{cn|date=April 2025}} He later held multiple positions at the [[Singapore Exchange]] (SGX), including: senior vice president, head of issuer regulation, chief of staff for risk management, and chief regulatory officer.<ref name=National/> He was CEO of the [[Abu Dhabi Global Market]] for six years starting in 2015.<ref name=BBC/>

Teng joined [[Binance]] in August 2021 as CEO of the company's Singapore business.<ref name=National/> He became regional head of Asia, Europe, and the [[Middle East and North Africa]], in April 2023,<ref name=BBC>{{cite news |last1=Oi |first1=Mariko |title=Richard Teng: Who is the new boss of Binance? |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/business-67493289 |publisher=[[BBC News]] |date=21 November 2023}}</ref> and was later the global head of regional markets.<ref name=Mint/><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Jeans |first1=David |title=Richard Teng A Top Contender For New Binance CEO As CZ Steps Down |journal=[[Forbes]] |date=November 21, 2023 |url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/davidjeans/2023/11/21/richard-teng-a-top-contender-for-new-binance-ceo-as-cz-steps-down/?sh=78e72156ef89}}</ref> He was named CEO of Binance in November 2023, replacing founder [[Changpeng Zhao]] who stepped down after pleading guilty to criminal charges related to his management of Binance.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Roberts |first1=Jeff John |title=New Binance CEO Richard Teng says firm has 'robust timeline' for board, financial disclosures |journal=[[Fortune (magazine)|Fortune]] |date=November 27, 2023 |url=https://fortune.com/crypto/2023/11/27/new-binance-ceo-richard-teng-board-financial-disclosures/}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Sigalos |first1=MacKenzie |last2=Browne |first2=Ryan |title=Changpeng Zhao speaks out after pleading guilty to criminal charges, names Richard Teng as new Binance CEO |url=https://www.cnbc.com/2023/11/21/changpeng-zhao-speaks-out-after-doj-plea-deal-names-new-binance-ceo.html |publisher=[[CNBC]] |date=November 21, 2023}}</ref> Previously, Teng was a board member of Abu Dhabi-based Lulu Financial Group in 2021–2022.<ref name=National/>
